steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What are you doing in Jessica's room, Vanilla?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Franka!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Ah, I'm helping her clean up.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...I guess our princess isn't going to be around the ship a lot, now that she's off at the frontier.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Yeah, Jessica and I talked it over. I'm cleaning up her room so I can mail her her stuff.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Need any help?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: No, I borrowed a few gadgets from Engineering. I can handle this on my own.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Guess you're not that little girl who used to walk into automatic doors anymore.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Teehee.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Franka.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Do you think Jessica was wrong?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: She told you to ask me that, didn't she?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Still worrying what other people think, even after making a decision like that?

spans.text: Still worrying what other people think, even after making a decision like

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I can't tell if she's actually grown up or not.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: ...I really admire her.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: She's willing to leave everything behind...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Heh, no need to rush to her defense.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Jessica has her fair share of problems, but she knows what she's doing.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I've known from the start that she's not the kind of person I need to be worrying about.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I just didn't expect her to make a decision so soon.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Soon?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Yeah. She's barely twenty. Practically a baby.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: She has plenty of time ahead of her.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But it's not a bad thing.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Sure beats being someone who could never make a choice at all.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I'm sorry!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I've been thinking about my future too, but I couldn't come to a decision...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh. Sorry, I wasn't talking about you.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You're pretty young too, aren't you?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I was taking about...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...Who was I talking about again?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I'll go look for a Messenger to make the delivery.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's me.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: A mission? I'll be there right away.
Find something to pass the time between missions.
Should be easy enough, she thinks.
As she prepares to leave the room, she hears a voice that makes her stop in her tracks.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: No, my plans haven't changed.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I still want to form my own security company.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Mr. Cliff wants to speak to me?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Understood. I'll return to HQ tomorrow.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka?
Normally, she would go over to her partner and make a face at her.
Maybe even play a practical joke or two, if she was in a good mood.
But today—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yes, she's aware.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'll discuss it with her.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...What am I running away from?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Good timing. I'm going back to HQ.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Something happen?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Like I told you before, I'm planning to talk to Mr. Cliff.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So you've made up your mind?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yes. Seeing Jessica's courage made me feel like I should be braver, too.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's a fine line between courage and recklessness. Sure you're ready to face the 'Clip'?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I don't mind coming with, for moral support.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...No, I've got to get used to it.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You don't have a deceptive bone in your body. You don't stand a chance against that sly old man.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You're in a bad mood today, aren't you?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And what does that have to do with anything?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I've been around you long enough to pick up a thing or two about reading people.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Looks like the teacher's pet has grown up, too.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We need to talk when I get back.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You serious?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Am I ever not?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'll be gone for a month or so. See you.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Okay, fine, maybe I'm not in the best mood.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Report.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: The intel was good. The bandits have taken the workers hostage and are holed up in the depot.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: They have equipment and numbers, but there are plenty of holes in their defenses.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: I'm sending you a map of the buildings and sentry positions.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Received.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Whew...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: I was worried that you and Liskarm would be wasted at a pharmaceutical company.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: But now I can see that what you do hasn't really changed.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You could've taken it easy if you applied to Logistics or HR, you know.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: No way. Field Operator pays well. Better than at Blacksteel, anyway.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: And I've always wanted to try my hand at this.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Being on the frontlines is no game.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Which is why I applied to join a mission with you two leading the charge.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Can't wait to study the veterans in action.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: There isn't much worth learning on the battlefield.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's not a place to spend your life.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Doesn't matter, knowledge is money, no matter where it comes from.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: I want to make money while I can, so I'll have the freedom to do what I want.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And what's that?

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Well, I haven't decided yet.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: But I will.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Must be nice to be young.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: You're not that much older than me.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Says the girl who's been my junior at both Blacksteel and Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: What, would you like a massage? A back rub?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: No thanks.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I'm sending over the operation plan now.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Wow, that was quick!

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: And really detailed!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I hope you've learned to respect your elders.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: I've always respected you, oh venerable one.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Team A will pin the enemy from the front, while Team B rescues the hostages.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Do you have enough people to pin them down?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Based on earlier intel, their leader is very cautious and may choose to flee if we deploy too many.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We don't want to have to chase them through the hills.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Still, this few people in Team A...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh, did no one ever tell you this?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: 'Keep an eye on Franka when Liskarm's away. Don't let her do anything reckless.'

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Er... just to be clear...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Yeah, I know. You didn't hear that from Liskarm herself.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Our honor student would have said it to my face.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But I guess we've been partners for too long.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So long that even Rhodes Island likes to stick us together.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Isn't that a good thing?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Why would you think that?

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Isn't it comforting to be with someone you can trust?

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: You have a tendency to seek thrills in battle, leading you to take dangerous actions.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: While Liskarm is cautious and tries to stop you.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: You often argue, but are the perfect partners to complete any missions assigned to you.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: That's what they say about you two back at Blacksteel, anyway.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Well, they're not wrong.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: The two of us have gotten used to it, is all.
The Vulpo sighs.
Most new Blacksteel members choose a standard-issue weapon when they join.
She picked a shortsword for self-defense, but the rapier remained her main weapon.
As time went on, people started to believe that she only used the rapier.
In fact, she is skilled with the shortsword too.
But it's been so long that even she herself has almost forgotten.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Let's do this quickly.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Franka pinned the enemy down while the rest of us rescued the hostages.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Then I turned around to see that they had surrounded her.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: My heart was practically in my throat at that point.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: They weren't very well-equipped, but they had the advantage of numbers.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: And they all wanted a piece of her after realizing they'd been fooled.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: But Franka just stood there like there was nothing to worry about.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: I thought maybe Liskarm's absence had made her go over the edge...

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: But then—

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Then?

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: This is an exclusive scoop. You didn't expect to hear it for free, did you?
Almond makes a money sign with her hand and smiles slyly.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: ...Alright, alright!

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You shouldn't be trying to make money off other people's stories.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: This is just an efficient use of resources!

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Oh, Liskarm! You're back.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Were you talking about Franka?

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Yup.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I want to hear it too.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Fine, fine, this one's on the house.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Thanks!

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Man, I'm starting to feel guilty.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Anyway!

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Franka was in the middle of the fray, while I was on the tower after getting the hostages out.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: We didn't plan any strict timing. She shouldn't have known where I was.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: But I saw her wink directly at me.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: With her gaze, she drew my attention to a teetering building on the other side.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Right next to the bandits.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: I got the message instantly.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: She didn't show herself just for the thrill of it. She lured them there on purpose.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: She even predicted that I would show up right where I did!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It's no superpower. She simply expected that enough time would have elapsed for you or some other team member to show up.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: What if we got delayed though?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Then she might have rendezvoused with you, or she might have had a Plan B.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If I were in her shoes, I might have set up explosives in the building.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Come to think of it, she did ask me for some explosives...

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Anyway, there was something different about Franka on this mission.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Calm, reliable... not to say she's not normally reliable, but—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Where is she now?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: She shut herself in her room after she got back.

steps.name: Almond
steps.text: Yeah... I wanted to celebrate with her.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...I'll go find her.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Almond is probably running her mouth off right about now.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Bah, it's none of my business.
Her mother's letter lies on the table.
She regularly sends her mother money and answers every question she has. She loves her.
But there are two questions that she always evades.
How long do you plan on risking your life as a mercenary?
When are you coming home?
They are, in fact, the same question.
She knows her mother is asking out of love, but these two questions mean more to her than anyone can imagine.
The Vulpo turns on the old record player that she got from Croissant.
Then, she sinks herself into the soft bed, as though trying to fall into an abyss where no one knows her.
She has never considered herself unprepared for the future.
She believes she is enjoying every second of the present.
But she felt a sense of loss when Jessica decided to go to the frontier. When Liskarm decided to form her own security company.
It isn't about uncertainty. She knows exactly where she should be heading.
It's—
She knows who this polite and rhythmic knocking belongs to.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: She knows I'm in here, and where I left the spare key.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Underneath the flower pot by the door.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Then, she'll open it up without hesitation.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Maybe I should change where I hide the key.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: This isn't like you, Franka.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And what would be?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...Anything but this.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Are you free right now, Teacher's Pet?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I wouldn't have come looking for you if I wasn't.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We haven't sparred in a while, have we?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So you just laid out all your ideals. As usual.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I don't know any other way.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Well, I guess it suits you better than trying to sweet talk him.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So how did it go?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Not great. Mr. Cliff is not fond of my choice.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But he did say he wouldn't mind having a far-off partner.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: There's no such thing as a real partnership between security companies. Once you leave Blacksteel, you're no friend of them.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I know.
The two of them walk towards opposite ends of the training ground.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You heard about it from Laura.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I know why you want to spar all of a sudden.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: So we'll spar to your heart's content today.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Aren't you getting a little carried away, Teacher's Pet?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I mean exactly what I said.
Sword and shield meet with a loud clang.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I also saw a few friends that I've kept in touch with since my trainee days.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Many of them are willing to come with me.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So you went back for a class reunion?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Not exactly, we just had a few chats.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: They all asked about you.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You always call me 'honor student' or 'teacher's pet,' but you were the one who was always at the top of the class.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Being an honor student isn't exactly a good thing for a warrior.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I disliked you from the moment I laid eyes on you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I remember the first time we faced off in a simulation.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What did I say?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You said, 'Let's see if the teacher's pet is so perfect in a real fight.'

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That's when it all started.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You sure can hold a grudge.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You could always stop calling me that.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: No way.
They know each other's moves well. The sound of weapons clanging against one another fills the room.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I mean, why would someone who's neither a wannabe warlord nor an arms dealer become a mercenary?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I still wonder that.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I don't need to hear that from someone who says she became one for the thrill of it.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Looks like our teacher's pet has learned a retort or two.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I learned from the best.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I saw the letter when I stepped into the room.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You haven't been back for years.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I don't know what to say when I see her.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I thought you got along well enough with your mother.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: More than well enough. I love her, and she loves me.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: She encouraged me to do what I wanted, and never forced me to do anything I didn't.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: She spoiled me into the woman I am today.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I can see that.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: There are a lot of mercenaries like me, at least in terms of personality.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But very few like you, who seek out danger rather than avoid it.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It took me a long time to realize why.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You could do that because you can afford to live a carefree life.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Yeah, you should see the pictures of me from when I was little.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Not to gloat, but you've never seen a more pampered princess.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Er, thanks, but no thanks.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Well, I'm not sure I have any of those around anyway.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I'm sure Mom kept them, though.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But the more I enjoy what I have now, the more afraid I am of seeing her.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I shouldn't have left her.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I should have stayed with her, started a little shop. All I needed was enough income to make a living.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But I couldn't resist my longing for... all this.
Franka points at her sword, then turns around to look at the spacious training ground.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: She was worried about me when I was a freelance mercenary.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So she sent me off to Blacksteel training camp with a smile.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But I know she cried as soon as I was out of sight.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Are you afraid you won't be able to leave once you go see her?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I'm afraid I wouldn't be able to stop myself from arguing with her.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Even though we love each other so much.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...I thought you were just in a bad mood.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Apparently you're in a very bad mood.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: All these years, and I've never heard you talk so much.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Yeah, our thing was always you talk, and I laugh at you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Your condition isn't getting worse, is it?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm fine.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's not any better, but it's not worse either.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I've gotten used to touching the hard bits when I take a shower.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Maybe I've gone crazy though. Who knows?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Not everyone needs a grand dream or ideal.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Feeling myself grow in battle, playing pranks on the people around me—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That's enough for me.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: From Blacksteel to Rhodes Island, I think I've been more happy than not.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And I thought I could go on like this.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Until you and Jessica both made your choices.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Then I realized I really, really couldn't.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So I had to ask myself—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Where do I go from here?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Everything came so easily to you, Franka. Everyone admired you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Myself included.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...Wait, really? You?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yes, me.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: The one who pulled me back on our first mission?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It didn't stop me from thinking you took way too many risks.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: For a long time, I didn't quite understand why I partnered with you. But now I've started to.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I could never tell what you were thinking, but I always wanted to know...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What kind of outlook on life did someone like you have, someone who is so different from me?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Maybe I instinctively realized that I could learn a lot from you.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I don't remember you learning anything from me.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I've learned plenty. Combat skills, witty retorts... maybe a positive mindset?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Or maybe it would be more accurate to say you forced me to pick them up on my own, to keep up with you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Take that mission you went on with Laura...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You're Franka.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You might look like you need someone to back you up, but you really don't.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: All you needed was someone to give you a little push.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Are you... breaking up with me?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I just wanted you to let you know—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You don't need to worry about me.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Well, you've definitely learned how to get on my nerves, at least.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I learned from the best.
The Thermite Blade pops out of her hand, drawing a dangerous arc as it flies through the air, while the Flash Shield slips from the Vouivre's hand and falls to the ground.
A draw, as usual.
But Franka did not pick up her weapon while making fun of Liskarm, as she normally did.
She simply stands there, lost in thought.
Liskarm waits.
Finally, Franka breaks the silence.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You said you needed to talk with me.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You want to invite me to join your new security company, don't you?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Well, I'm not going.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Okay.
Liskarm picks up the Thermite Blade, and Franka the Flash Shield, and they both toss them to the other.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: My condition has mostly stabilized.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I want to take a long vacation. Go home and spend some time with my mom.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Maybe have a big fight with her.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And then... I think I'm going to go on a long trip.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: A long-term field mission, maybe, to some place far away.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You might even have your company up and running by the time I get back.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Then when the time comes, I'll invite you to hang out.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Don't get ahead of yourself.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You're the one who followed me to Rhodes Island, remember?

spans.text: the one who followed me to Rhodes Island, remember?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Maybe someday, after I leave this place, I'll go shamelessly hang out at your office without asking.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Sorry, but you know me. Rules are more important than relationships.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Well, then I guess I'll hang out outside your office and put up a sign with all your most embarrassing secrets.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...How the hell did I end up getting to know someone like you?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You know, that's a great question. My condolences.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So what's for lunch?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Who's buying?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Fine, me. Just for today.
